Scene 9, EXT·D, Rayapuram Bus Stand, Grey light. The bus idles in its bay, engine coughing., 3/8 pages, estimated 1h 30m
Scene 10, INT·D, Farooq's Bus - Moving, The bus rattles through paddy fields. Every window is open. A goat stands in the aisle, its owner asleep., 5/8 pages, estimated 2h
Scene 11, EXT·D, Coastal Highway, A straight road between casuarina trees. The wind pushes the trees all one way., 2/8 pages, estimated 1h
Scene 12, EXT·D, Coastal Highway - Checkpost, The tower still stands. The equipment is half dead. The storm is coming faster than the forecast., 6/8 pages, estimated 1h 15m
Scene 13, EXT·D, Pedda Revu - Beach, Wide flat sand. A row of FISHING BOATS pulled high above the tide line, painted blue and red. Nets drying on poles., 3/8 pages

Scene 14, EXT·D, Pedda Revu - Community Radio Hut, A whitewashed hut on a low rise above the village, its paint gone grey. Beside it, a lattice STEEL TOWER, forty metres high, red and white bands faded to pink …, 3/8 pages
Scene 15, INT·D, Community Radio Hut, Dust in slanting light. A bird's nest on the mixing desk. Posters for health camps from twenty years ago., 3/8 pages
Scene 16, EXT·N, Padma's House - Veranda, A kerosene LANTERN on the floor. Padma serves rice and fish curry on banana leaves. Bittu eats with both hands. Farooq has joined them., 5/8 pages
Scene 17, INT·N, Community Radio Hut, Lantern light. Lakshmi and Venkat Rao work side by side. She tests valves with the multimeter. He sorts them into good and bad piles on a newspaper., 3/8 pages
Scene 18, EXT·N, Pedda Revu - Beach, Bittu and two other CHILDREN sit on an upturned boat watching the sea. The waves are higher than usual and very loud., 3/8 pages
Scene 19, INT·N, Farooq's Bus - Parked, Farooq lies across the back seat, a towel over his eyes. A small battery RADIO on his chest plays only static., 2/8 pages

Scene 20, EXT·D, Community Radio Hut - Tower Base, Morning. Grey clouds racing. Lakshmi straps on an old CLIMBING HARNESS from the hut. Venkat Rao holds a coil of ANTENNA WIRE and will not let go of it., 4/8 pages
Scene 21, EXT·D, Tower - Top, Wind. The whole tower hums. Lakshmi clips in, one rung, then the next. Far below, the village is small and the sea is enormous., 4/8 pages
Scene 22, INT·D, Community Radio Hut, Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust., 4/8 pages
Scene 23, EXT·D, Pedda Revu - Fishing Boat, Padma's boat, LAKSHMI DEVI painted on the bow in curling letters. Padma unscrews a heavy MARINE BATTERY from under the deck boards., 3/8 pages
Scene 24, INT·N, Community Radio Hut, The spare transformer wired in. The battery on the floor, clamps attached. Lakshmi checks every joint with the lantern., 3/8 pages
Scene 25, INT·N, Primary Health Centre, The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen., 6/8 pages
Scene 26, EXT·N, Pedda Revu - Village Lane, Rain sideways. Palm fronds tear loose and skid down the lane. A dog runs past with nowhere to go., 2/8 pages
Scene 27, INT·N, Community Radio Hut, Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch., 5/8 pages
Scene 28, INT·N, District Office - Control Room, A room of radios and one tired computer. Suresh, sleeves rolled up, drinks tea from a paper cup. A RECEIVER on the shelf crackles to life., 3/8 pages
